description: Canonical capability registry. Declares the providers (tools/MCP servers) currently available to the toolchain and the capabilities they enable. SYSTEM-ENGINEERING governs the USE of these capabilities; it does not own the providers. This file is the single source of truth for the MCP -> capability mapping and must never be duplicated as hard-coded strings across the codebase.

capabilities.description: Read files and directories in the workspace.
Search the workspace by name, pattern and content (glob/grep).
Create, edit and move files in the workspace.
Query current documentation for libraries, frameworks and runtimes.
Deliberate, structured and revisable reasoning over complex problems.
Open and inspect a page in a real browser (headless Chrome/Edge via Playwright).
Capture structural/accessibility snapshot (landmarks, headings, images, alt).
Capture viewport and full-page screenshots of a rendered page.
Pixel-level review of screenshots against DESIGN.md by a vision-capable model (DeepSeek flash accepts JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP). Requires a provider key; not observable in this environment.
Search the web for relevant URLs, snippets, and metadata.
Fetch and extract clean markdown content from a web page.
Extract structured data from web pages (parse, map, crawl).
Synthesize grounded answers from multiple web sources with citations.
